name: inspira-gradient-button
blurb: Button with rotating rainbow conic-gradient border.
description: A button with a continuously rotating conic-gradient border using CSS keyframe animation. Accepts customizable colors, duration, blur, and border radius.
use_when: You need an eye-catching CTA with colorful continuous motion.
avoid_when: On accessible-first interfaces or when animation must be subtle.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Animated border is purely visual. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
